card.name: The capital letter K starting a word
card.fires_on: The single capital letter K as a separate piece, either starting a capitalized word or name (Kerry, Kings, Kendall) or inside all-caps words (LIKELY, HAIKU).

modes.label: K inside all-caps words
modes.description: K appears partway through an upper-case word such as LIKELY or LIKELIHOOD.
modes.example: THESE REACTIONS ARE MORE LI<<K>>ELY TO OCCUR IN INDIVID

modes.label: K starting a capitalized name or word
modes.description: K begins a proper name or a title-case word, often after a quote mark or space.
modes.example: How do you know that everybody that voted “<<K>>erry” on that box got saved in

modes.label: K as a unit symbol
modes.description: K stands as the kilo prefix in a physics formula.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are unrelated, with the suppressed ones mostly meaning competition, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the lone letter K when a word starts or continues with K, mostly in names or capitals.
